description: MooseX::App is a framework for building complex, multi-command command-line interfaces using Moose. Use when user asks to create CLI tools with subcommands, define command-line flags as class attributes, or generate automatic documentation for Perl utilities.
overview: MooseX::App is a framework for building complex, multi-command CLI tools by leveraging the power of Moose. It allows developers to treat CLI commands as objects, where each command is a separate class and command-line flags are defined as class attributes. This approach promotes code reuse, type safety, and automatic documentation generation, making it ideal for creating professional-grade Perl utilities with minimal boilerplate.
